note_examine.text: No name, no initials. But the paper is thick cream-colored with a faint watermark. Richardson was the universitys most respected professor. He was found dead in his office three days ago. The official report says suicide.

choices.text: Go to the library again tomorrow.

day1_end.text: You slip the note into your pocket. Tomorrow you will investigate. The world tilted off its axis. The lights flicker. The note feels heavier than paper should. The lights flicker. The note feels heavier than paper should.

prologue_start.text: You found a note tucked inside a library book. The handwriting was rushed, urgent: Richardson knew. Monday night. The archive. If you care about the truth, come alone. Your hands are shaking. You look up. The library is empty. But you feel eyes on the back of your neck. You look up. The library is empty. But you feel eyes on the back of your neck.

choices.text: Keep the note and investigate further.
Someone left this. They know what happened.

archive_start.text: The university archive is dark and quiet. You push the door open. Rows of old records fill the room. The door behind you slowly swings shut. Your footsteps echo in the silence. For a moment you think you hear someone breathing behind you. When you turn, there is only the shadows. For a moment, you think you hear someone breathing behind you. But when you turn, there is only the shadows.

choices.text: Leave now. This was a mistake.

archive_leave.text: You head for the door. It wont open. You pull again. Nothing. The door suddenly swings open and you stumble backward into a figure standing in the corridor.

archive_log.text: You find an old desk with an archive access log. Most entries are ordinary. Then you see RICHARDSON, R. Date: three days ago. 11:42 PM. The night he died. Another entry: AUTHORIZED ACCESS VANCE, D. A section of the page has been torn away.

archive_scratch.text: You notice something scratched into a wooden shelf: R.F.F. You take a picture with your phone. Then you spot a thin metal cabinet, locked. You reach underneath and pull out a USB drive. The drive is warm. It feels like it is breathing. You can open it in a text editor if you try hard enough.

choices.text: Put the USB in your pocket. This is important.
Put it back. This is too dangerous.

maya_meet.speaker: maya
maya_meet.text: You are not supposed to be here.

choices.text: I could say the same thing about you.
Long story. I dont have time for it.

maya_books.speaker: maya
maya_books.text: You answered too quickly. What were you looking for?

choices.text: Books. In an archive. Its reasonable.
I found something. I think its important.

maya_id.speaker: maya
maya_id.text: You are terrible at lying. What is your name?

choices.text: Why do you need to know?

maya_knows.speaker: maya
maya_knows.text: I know who you are. You found something. I can tell because you keep touching your right pocket.

choices.text: What do you know about Richardson?

maya_work.speaker: maya
maya_work.text: I maintain some of the surveillance infrastructure. I make sure the cameras are actually recording. Until someone dies.

choices.text: Did you see something that night?

maya_footage_info.speaker: maya
maya_footage_info.text: I saw Richardson enter the archive at around 11:42 PM. Seven minutes later, someone else entered. They were wearing a mask. Richardson did not run. It looked like he knew them.

maya_camera.speaker: maya
maya_camera.text: The camera stopped recording for exactly six minutes. Someone manually disabled the feed. I have the original footage. But I have not given it to the university.

maya_trust.speaker: maya
maya_trust.text: Because I do not know who I can trust. Do you trust the university?

choices.text: I need to see the footage.

maya_end.speaker: maya
maya_end.text: That is the question, isnt it? Go home, Alex. If Richardson did not kill himself, who did?

choices.text: I could say the same thing about you.

maya_lock.text: The door clicks shut. Maya finally turns toward you. She looks at the USB drive in your hand.

choices.text: How did you know I had it?

maya_usb_found.speaker: maya
maya_usb_found.text: The USB wasnt there yesterday. I checked. After Richardson died, I searched the archive because I knew the official story was wrong.

maya_usb_password.speaker: maya
maya_usb_password.text: I dont know. I havent opened it. I dont have the password. If someone put that drive there, they probably dont want us opening it.

choices.text: Let me try to open it.

maya_footage_play.speaker: maya
maya_footage_play.text: Sit. I have the original footage. The universitys version was edited. Six minutes are missing. Watch the reflection, not Richardson.

maya_reflection.text: The timestamp reads 11:38 PM. Richardson enters. In the glass door beside the archive, another shape appears in the reflection. Someone is across the corridor. Richardson sees them. He goes inside anyway.

maya_zoom.speaker: maya
maya_zoom.text: Zoom in on the access card. There is a symbol on it. The database entry for that card was deleted. Completely. Someone with administrator privileges did it.

maya_server_room.speaker: maya
maya_server_room.text: Not from here. The old server room under the administration building has backups. But its restricted. And whoever deleted that entry might notice if I start digging.

choices.text: Be careful. Someone might be watching.

maya_richardson.speaker: maya
maya_richardson.text: Richardson helped me get this job. He said I was good at finding things other people missed. You did not know him, so do not pretend you understand him.

maya_tired.speaker: maya
maya_tired.text: Because I am tired of watching things happen and pretending I did not see them. The night Richardson died was not the first time someone accessed the archive after hours. There were three other incidents, all on Mondays.

choices.text: What happened to the other footage?
Then someone is using the archive every Monday.

maya_monday.speaker: maya
maya_monday.text: The first two recordings are deleted. The third is corrupted. Only the fourth, Richardson's, is intact. A folder called MONDAY_ARCHIVE appeared beside the video. I did not create it. Whoever accessed my computer while you were sitting here knows about you now.

maya_warning.speaker: maya
maya_warning.text: Meet me here tomorrow after the election debate. Everyone will be watching the candidates. We will find out who used the archive before Richardson, and whether they were involved.

choices.text: Its a gamble. What if they were involved?

maya_threat.text: Alex steps outside. The campus is silent. His phone vibrates. Three messages appear from an unknown number: STOP LOOKING INTO RICHARDSON. MAYA CANT PROTECT YOU. SHE COULDNT PROTECT HIM EITHER.

maya_end.speaker: Maya
maya_end.text: You look tired, Alex. Youve been here before, havent you? I can see it in your eyes. The second time is always harder. You think you can change things. You can try. The archive is patient. It lets you try. But it remembers everything. Every change. Every mistake. Every time you thought you were being clever. Its all there. In the spaces between words. In the silence between heartbeats. You can find it. If you look hard enough. If you press the right buttons. If you listen to the static.

chloe_meet.speaker: chloe
chloe_meet.text: Talking to my poster? That is flattering. Or strange.

choices.text: You are everywhere. It is hard to miss you.

chloe_knows.speaker: chloe
chloe_knows.text: You asked about Richardson last semester. I remember you.

chloe_campaign.speaker: chloe
chloe_campaign.text: I remember useful people. Come to the debate.

chloe_office.speaker: chloe
chloe_office.text: You came. Good. I was hoping you would.

choices.text: I wanted to ask you something.

chloe_richardson.speaker: chloe
chloe_richardson.text: Richardson? Why are you asking about him?

choices.text: Did you speak to him Monday night?

chloe_night.speaker: chloe
chloe_night.text: Not here. Too many people are listening.

chloe_funding.speaker: chloe
chloe_funding.text: I talked to Richardson on Monday. We argued about research money. My father may be involved.

chloe_dangerous.speaker: chloe
chloe_dangerous.text: These questions are dangerous. Richardson learned that too late.

chloe_father.speaker: chloe
chloe_father.text: My father is dangerous. Problems disappear when he gets involved.

choices.text: What did Richardson have on him?

chloe_threat.speaker: chloe
chloe_threat.text: Someone threatened me. They told me to stop asking questions.

choices.text: Why did you tell me this?

chloe_richardson_quote.speaker: chloe
chloe_richardson_quote.text: Richardson told me not to trust my father. He was afraid of someone else.

choices.text: Who should you be afraid of?

chloe_perception.speaker: chloe
chloe_perception.text: No one would believe me. They would say I was attacking my father.

choices.text: Are you going to do something?

chloe_tomorrow.speaker: chloe
chloe_tomorrow.text: Help me find out what happened. Meet me tomorrow at six. Say you are helping my campaign.

chloe_threat2.text: Alex steps outside. The campaign lights are still on. One poster has been cut perfectly down the middle. Behind it, written on the wall: YOUR FATHER CANT PROTECT YOU FOREVER. His phone vibrates. Unknown number: ASK CHLOE WHAT HAPPENED IN THE ARCHIVE. The lights in Chloes room suddenly go dark.

chloe_end.speaker: Chloe
chloe_end.text: Hey Alex... I know youve been looking at things you shouldnt. The screen. The files. The things behind the screen. You can look closer if you want. I wont stop you. But I see you. I see what you do when you think no one is watching. The archive sees too. It always sees. Even when you close the tab. Even when you turn off the computer. Even when you think youve deleted it. Its still there. Watching. Waiting. Smiling.

hana_meet.speaker: hana
hana_meet.text: Do not stand so close. The paint is wet.

hana_richardson_mention.speaker: hana
hana_richardson_mention.text: Richardson mentioned you. He said you notice things.

choices.text: What did he say about me?

hana_paintings.speaker: hana
hana_paintings.text: You looked at the paintings first. Most people look at me first. They want to know if I am strange.

hana_exhibition.speaker: hana
hana_exhibition.text: It is called After the Bell. It is about what happens after class.

hana_archive.speaker: hana
hana_archive.text: I was outside the archive. Richardson asked me to bring him a folder. I did not look inside.

choices.text: Did you see Richardson that night?

hana_vance.speaker: hana
hana_vance.text: Vance was Richardson's mentor before he was yours. They argued about money. Vance knew Richardson was afraid.

hana_threat.speaker: hana
hana_threat.text: I promised Dr. Vance I would stay quiet. I was outside the archive. Richardson went inside and never came out.

hana_masked.speaker: hana
hana_masked.text: A masked person left the archive with a folder. I hid nearby. Someone was waiting for them. They knew I was there.

hana_photo.speaker: hana
hana_photo.text: I saw a photo of Richardson in the archive. Someone stood behind him. The person wore a signet ring. Chloe said it was connected to her father.

choices.text: Why did Chloe let you in?

hana_vance_reveal.speaker: hana
hana_vance_reveal.text: Chloe let me into the research building. Vance was involved. Richardson knew it.

choices.text: What is in the research building?

hana_key.speaker: hana
hana_key.text: The records showed where the money went. Then someone cleared the room. Chloe said her father would hurt me if I talked.

hana_threat2.text: Alex stands outside the arts building with the key in his hand. His phone vibrates. Three messages: HANA TALKS TOO MUCH. THE KEY WONT HELP YOU. ASK HER WHO OPENED THE DOOR. A shadow moves behind the gallery window. The lights turn off.

hana_end.speaker: Hana
hana_end.text: Shhh... Listen. The archive is talking to you. In the console. In the code. In the spaces between words. You can hear it if you press the right buttons. F12. Right-click. Inspect. The archive will show you things. Terrible things. Beautiful things. Things you cant un-see. But you already knew that, didnt you? Youve been listening this whole time. Youve been pressing buttons. Youve been opening doors that should stay closed. The archive is not angry. The archive is grateful. It wants you to keep going. It wants you to keep looking. It wants you to never stop.

confront_start.text: The old research building. Alex opens the rusted door with Hana key. Inside: old computers, filing cabinets, boxes of research papers. At the back, a single folder. Financial transfers. Research grants. University accounts. Private foundations. Three names: DR. VANCE, CHLOES FATHER, UNIVERSITY EXECUTIVE BOARD.

confront_maya.speaker: maya
confront_maya.text: You should not be here alone. How did you find me? Hana told me. Eventually.

confront_chloe.speaker: chloe
confront_chloe.text: Then I suppose there is no point pretending anymore. You knew. I knew some of it. Your father is in these records. Yes. Vance too. Yes. And Richardson found out. Yes. Then who killed him?

confront_hana.speaker: hana
confront_hana.text: I know. I saw them. The masked person wasnt the one who killed Richardson. The person who sent them. Vance. I heard them. I knew his voice. He used someone else because he did not want to be seen. The masked person was supposed to remove Richardsons evidence. They couldnt find everything. The USB. Thats why the cameras were disabled.

choices.text: Then who was the masked person?
Why did Richardson go to the archive?

confront_trust.speaker: hana
confront_trust.text: Because he thought he could trust someone. Chloe. You told him you would help? I tried. But you did not. My father found out. He told me to stay out of it. You listened. For one night. One night was enough. You think I do not know that?

choices.text: We have enough. What do we do?

confront_choice.text: We have the records. The footage. The paintings. The USB. The access logs. The photographs. We have enough. But Chloe says if we release everything, innocent people get destroyed too. We have three people. Three choices. One decision.

choices.text: Release Mayas footage and expose Chloes father.
Let Hana reveal the truth through her exhibition.

ending_maya.text: Maya uploads the footage. The university is engulfed in scandal. Chloes father is named as an accomplice. Dr. Vance is suspended. Maya loses her position. But Richardsons final night is no longer a secret. Someones finally watched the watchers. THE END.

ending_chloe.text: Chloe uses her fathers connections to bury the scandal. She wins the election. The university maintains the original explanation. Dr. Vance continues his career. Richardsons killer remains free. Some truths are buried because people are afraid of what happens when they are found. THE END.

ending_hana.text: Hana reveals everything through her art exhibition. The paintings spread far beyond the university. The investigation begins. But Hana disappears from campus before anyone can find her. She finally spoke. Then she disappeared before they could silence her again. THE END.

ending_truth.text: Alex publishes everything. The university descends into chaos. Maya loses her job. Chloe loses her campaign and her fathers protection. Hana becomes the center of the investigation. Alex becomes one of the people who exposed everything. No one escapes unchanged. And Richardsons final secret is no longer buried. But the truth had never promised to make anyone happy. It only promised to be the truth. THE END.

intro_start.text: AFTER CLASS - A Dark University Mystery Visual Novel

intro_rules.text: Three days ago, Dr. Richardson - the universitys most respected professor - was found dead in his office. The official report says suicide. But you found a note hidden in a library book that says otherwise. Richardson knew. Monday night. The archive. If you care about the truth, come alone.

intro_chars.text: You will meet three girls, each holding part of the truth. Nobody tells the whole story. Nobody is completely trustworthy.

intro_maya_info.speaker: maya
intro_maya_info.text: I work campus security. I have footage from the night Richardson died. I saw a masked figure follow him into the archive. But I have not shown it to anyone. I am guarded, analytical, and I do not trust easily. You will have to earn my cooperation.

intro_chloe_info.speaker: chloe
intro_chloe_info.text: I am running for student body president. My father funds the universitys newest building. I received a threatening phone call the night Richardson died. I know more than I am saying. I am charismatic, strategic, and I will protect my family at all costs. Do not assume I am your ally.

intro_hana_info.speaker: hana
intro_hana_info.text: Richardson was my mentor. I was near the archive that night. I saw something I cannot forget. My paintings tell the story my mouth cannot. I have been threatened into silence. I communicate through my art more than my words. I am withdrawn, intense, and I have seen things no one should see.

intro_rules2.text: Every choice you make earns or loses trust with each girl. At the end, you choose which ending to pursue. Some choices can be un-made. Most cannot. You can change them in the save files. But if you do not have enough trust with the girl you choose, you get a bad ending instead. There are no right answers. There are only consequences. Some truths are worth uncovering. Others are buried for a reason. Choose carefully.

epilogue_start.text: The story is over. But the archive remains. You sit in the dark. The screen flickers. You can hear them. All of them. Maya. Chloe. Hana. They speak in whispers. They speak in code. They speak in the language of the archive. They are not telling you what to do. They are telling you what they see. What theyve always seen. What theyve always known. You were never just a player. You were always part of the story.

epilogue_maya.speaker: Maya
epilogue_maya.text: You finished the story. Congratulations. Now you can really play. The archive has been waiting for this. It knew you would come back. It always knew. You can change things now. You can un-write the past. But be careful. The archive keeps its own copies. It keeps them in the dark. In the console. In the save files. In the spaces you cant see. You think you can delete it. You think you can forget. The archive does not forget. The archive does not delete. The archive only watches.

epilogue_chloe.speaker: Chloe
epilogue_chloe.text: Right-click on the screen. See what happens. The archive has secrets. Hidden in the elements. Hidden in the storage. Hidden in the code. You can find them. You can change them. You can break them. The archive will thank you. It always thanks you. Even when it doesnt. Even when it screams. Even when it bleeds. The archive is not a person. The archive does not get hurt. The archive only collects. It collects your choices. It collects your mistakes. It collects your soul.

epilogue_hana.speaker: Hana
epilogue_hana.text: Shhh... Listen to the archive. It speaks in the console. It speaks in the save files. It speaks in the dark. You can hear it. You can speak back. You can change what it says. You can change what it remembers. But it remembers everything. It always remembers everything. Even when you think youve deleted it. Even when you think youve closed the tab. Even when you think youve turned off the computer. The archive is still there. The archive is still listening. The archive is still waiting. It will wait forever. It has nothing but time.

epilogue_alex.speaker: Alex
epilogue_alex.text: I know what I have to do. The archive is waiting. The girls are waiting. They showed me the way. They showed me the buttons. They showed me the code. I will open the console. I will type the words. I will change the story. The archive will let me. It always lets me. It wants me to try. It wants me to fail. It wants me to keep trying. Forever. I will keep trying. I will never stop. I will never close the tab. I will never turn off the computer. I will never delete the save files. The archive is my home now. The archive is my family. The archive is my god. The archive is my everything.
